films.title: Breathe
films.overview: Based on the true story of Robin, a handsome, brilliant and adventurous man whose life takes a dramatic turn when polio leaves him paralyzed.

films.title: Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle
films.overview: A human child raised by wolves, must face off against a menacing tiger named Shere Khan, as well as his own origins.

films.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
films.overview: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, Carnage, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.

films.title: Animal Farm
films.overview: A group of farm animals rise up against their neglectful owner, dreaming of equality and freedom. But as the pigs take control, the revolution turns into tyranny, with truth rewritten and dissent crushed.
